versions.changelog:
- **Initial release of “humanize-text” (文案去AI味优化器)**
- Detects and fixes mechanical, templated, or overly polite expressions in AI-generated text
- Makes content sound more like it’s written by a real person; suitable for social posts, customer support, and product intros
- Outlines six “AI flavor” detection points (e.g., cliché openings, long sentences, formal language)
- Provides specific optimization guidelines for self-media and customer service scenarios
- Includes before/after examples for practical reference
